summary: Comprehensive backend testing of SCORM export robustness fixes. All 18/18 tests passed. Core functionality verified: asyncio.to_thread() prevents event loop blocking, export completes in 1.16s (well under 30s Cloudflare limit), health endpoint responds during exports, and Optional fields (backgroundImage, element.src) handle None correctly. Identified incomplete coverage for required model fields and a critical disk space issue.

critical.issue: Defensive or'' None checks in scorm_exporter.py are NEVER REACHED for required model fields. When slide.width=None, slide.height=None, SlideAudio.src=None, GlobalAudio.src=None, or SlideElement.type=None are in MongoDB, Pydantic raises ValidationError at Project(**project_doc) BEFORE the exporter code runs. Backend returns 500 (Cloudflare wraps to 520). Confirmed via localhost:8001 direct test: returns HTTP 500 in 0.014s (not a hang).
critical.rca: Models define width/height as float (not Optional), src in SlideAudio/GlobalAudio as str (not Optional), type in SlideElement as str (not Optional). None values in these fields fail Pydantic v2 validation at model instantiation. The defensive code in scorm_exporter.py (lines 282, 304, 387, 395) is unreachable for these cases.
critical.fix_suggestion: Option 1: Make fields Optional in models.py: width: Optional[float] = 960, height: Optional[float] = 540, src: Optional[str] = None for SlideAudio/GlobalAudio, type: Optional[str] = None for SlideElement. Option 2: Pre-sanitize project_doc dict before Project(**project_doc) to replace None values with defaults.

critical.issue: DISK SPACE EXHAUSTION: /app partition (9.8GB) was at 100% full during testing due to 5.8GB of accumulated export files in /app/backend/storage/exports/ (118 ZIPs + 141 HTMLs). This caused 'No space left on device' errors in the first test run. Manually cleaned 259 old export files to restore 5GB free space.
critical.fix_suggestion: Add cleanup logic in server.py: after successful export, delete exports older than N days. Or limit exports dir to max size with LRU eviction. Example: clean up files older than 24 hours when creating new exports.

minor.issue: SCORM ZIP for NR01 project is 45MB because the exporter copies ALL 43 global AI-generated assets into every package (lines 241-254 in scorm_exporter.py), even those not referenced by the course. Should only include assets actually referenced in slide elements/backgroundImages.

cloudflare_behavior_note: In this environment, Cloudflare converts backend HTTP 500 responses to 520 ('Unknown Error'). Confirmed: localhost:8001 direct calls return proper HTTP 500 for Pydantic validation failures. The 520 is a proxy behavior, not a server crash. Tests accept 520 as equivalent to 500 for graceful error cases.
action_items: CRITICAL: Fix disk space exhaustion - add export file cleanup/retention policy (delete files older than 24h or limit exports dir size)

HIGH: Complete None-safety fix for required model fields: make Slide.width/height Optional[float], SlideAudio.src Optional[str], GlobalAudio.src Optional[str], SlideElement.type Optional[str] - OR add pre-sanitization of project_doc before Project(**project_doc) in the export endpoint
LOW: Optimize ZIP size by only including assets referenced in the course content, not all global assets (currently 43 global images are bundled into every export causing 45MB ZIPs)
critical_code_review_comments: scorm_exporter.py lines 282-296: defensive 'or empty string' check for backgroundImage is CORRECT and working (Optional field)

scorm_exporter.py lines 304, 387, 395: defensive 'or empty string' checks for element.src, audio.src, globalAudio.src are DEAD CODE for required fields - Pydantic validation blocks before these lines are reached
server.py lines 1148-1153: loop over slide elements accesses element.type (required str) - defensively typed in exporter but not protected at model loading stage
server.py line 1167-1175: asyncio.to_thread() is CORRECTLY implemented - keeps event loop free during CPU+IO intensive export operation. VERIFIED WORKING.
models.py SlideAudio: src: str (required) and filename: str (required) should be Optional[str] to match real-world data where audio may be partially configured
models.py GlobalAudio: src: str and filename: str should be Optional[str]
models.py Slide: width/height have defaults but are not Optional - passing None from DB causes Pydantic v2 ValidationError
No export retention/cleanup policy - /app partition filled to 100% during testing from accumulated export files
seed_data_creation: Used existing project NR01 (57d237b2-3636-4ea8-a306-bede62e4fe23). Created and auto-deleted 7 test projects (TEST_None_*) for robustness tests.

incomplete_none_fix.bug: scorm_exporter.py defensive None checks don't protect against required model field validation failures
incomplete_none_fix.root_cause: Pydantic v2 raises ValidationError at Project(**project_doc) in server.py line 1144 when required fields (type: str, src: str, width: float, height: float) are None in the MongoDB document. The exporter code with 'or empty_string' guards is NEVER executed in these cases.
incomplete_none_fix.reproduction: 1. POST /api/course/{id}/save with audio.src=null in course dict. 2. POST /api/course/{id}/export-scorm. 3. Backend logs ValidationError, returns 500 (or 520 via CF).
incomplete_none_fix.mitigation: Make affected model fields Optional in models.py OR add a sanitize_project_doc() function before Pydantic instantiation to replace None with defaults

disk_space.bug: /app partition 100% full due to accumulated export files
disk_space.root_cause: No retention policy for /app/backend/storage/exports/. Multiple export runs (especially during testing) accumulate large files (45MB ZIPs, 4-8MB HTMLs) without cleanup
disk_space.mitigation: Add cleanup_old_exports() call in the export endpoint after successful export. Delete files older than 24h or keep only last N exports per project.

cloudflare_520.observation: Cloudflare proxy in this environment converts all backend HTTP 500 responses to 520 Unknown Error
cloudflare_520.impact: Tests must accept both 500 and 520 as valid error responses. Client-side code must handle 520 as a server error.
cloudflare_520.backend_behavior: Confirmed correct: backend returns proper HTTP 500 with JSON {detail: 'SCORM export failed: ...'} when called via localhost:8001. No crash, no hang.
